assumptions.assumption: The web server is reachable from the internet because it serves the public site.
assumptions.basis: The source calls it the public site and says readers hit the web server over HTTPS.

assumptions.assumption: The CMS presents a web interface and is internet-facing because it runs the public site on the web server.
assumptions.basis: The CMS runs the public site, which readers access through the web server.

assumptions.assumption: The CMS is internet-facing because it runs the public site.
assumptions.basis: The CMS is stated to run on the web server serving the public site.

assumptions.assumption: The MySQL database contains confidential data because it stores accounts and comments as well as pages.
assumptions.basis: The source states that the database stores accounts and comments; these contents may contain information whose disclosure harms people or the business.

assumptions.assumption: The CDN is a separate party-controlled trust zone because the text describes a CDN and its bucket separately from the hosted network.
assumptions.basis: The CDN is described as a separate service with its own bucket, distinct from the web server and the same hosted network.

assumptions.assumption: The CDN bucket contains public data because readers fetch the published assets from the CDN.
assumptions.basis: The source says readers fetch the images, stylesheets and downloads from the CDN.
